name: Workshop POEMA SUELTO: Publication in Non-traditional Formats (Bookmaking) by Nicole Cecilia Delgado
description:
Join us on August 2nd at 14 for this book-making workshop with Nicole Cecilia Delgado of the renown publishing project La Impresora to explore the general features of the editorial process for creating low-cost publications. Using analogous design techniques, participants will learn to make four different single-page publication formats inspired by the non-traditional formats of the Poema Suelto series from La Impresora. 

You can reserve your spot by writing via email to reddoorcph@gmail.com
Register here: 
https://reddoormagazine.com/product/workshop-poema-suelto-publication-in-non-traditional-formats-bookmaking-aug-02-25/

Agenda

1-Presentation and show and tell of single-page publications by La Impresora

2-Hands-on workshop: How to make four different publication formats

Materials and snacks included.

-Paper of different sizes and colors, cardboard
-Pencils, markers and sharpies
-Magazines and newspapers for collage making
-Rulers
-Scissors
-Glue
-Participants are encouraged to bring texts (their's or other's) to create an original design

Price: 400dkk


-Refreshments will be provided by the gallery

Simultaneously, get inspired through a BOOK SHOW at Red Door:


La Impresora Reading Room
Pop-up library and reading room with a selection of books published by La Impresora, a small-scale poetry press and Risograph studio from Puerto Rico.

ABOUT THE WORKSHOP FACILITATOR:

Nicole Cecilia Delgado (www.nicolececiliadelgado.net) is a poet, translator, and book artist born in San Juan, Puerto Rico. Her writing, often reviewed within the framework of ecofeminism and land art, explores the subtleties and contrasts of everyday Puerto Rican and Caribbean life. 
Her collection of poems Periodo especial (Ediciones Aguadulce & La Impresora, 2019), deals with the fiscal crisis in Puerto Rico through the socioeconomic mirrors of the Greater Antilles. She recently published A mano/By Hand, an autobiographical essay about independent publishing (Ugly Duckling Presse Pamphlet Series 2020, La Impresora/EEE, 2023), and the bilingual poetry anthology Adjacent Islands/islas adyacentes (Ugly Duckling Presse, 2022, translated to English by Urayoán Noel).  She is the founder and co-director of La Impresora, a poetry press and Risograph print shop dedicated to small-scale editorial work in Puerto Rico. 
She is one of the 2025 Artists in Residence at Artica Svalvard, nominated by the Queen Sonja Print Award. 



Some press:
https://www.articasvalbard.no/news/introducing-the-2025-artica-svalbard-nominees-selected-by-the-queen-sonja-print-award


https://www.chicagoreview.org/impression-techniques-spending-time-with-the-two-women-behind-la-impresora-in-puerto-rico/


https://www.vabook.org/2022/02/24/nicole-delgado-artist-in-residence/



https://www.hercampus.com/school/uprm/puerto-rican-women-killing-it-independent-art-scene-nicole-cecilia-delgado-poueymirou/

CURRENTLY ON EXHIBIT AT RED DOOR: 
Puerto Rico en mi corazón

Puerto Rico En Mi Corazón is a collection of broadsides of contemporary Puerto Rican poets, in English and in Spanish. Edited by Roque Salas Rivera, E. Rowan Mena, Ricardo Alberto Maldonado, and Carina del Valle Schorske, coordinated by Anomalous Press.

Including poems by Yolanda Arroyo Pizarro, Andrés Cerpa, Kenneth Cumba, Joey de Jesus, Nicole Delgado, Martín Espada, Cindy Jimenez Vera, Yara Liceaga, Ricardo Maldonado, Lara Mimosa Montes, Urayoan Noel, Mara Pastor, Yolanda Rivera Castillo, Gaddiel Francisco Ruiz Rivera, Nicole Seale, Vincent Toro, and Xavier Valcárcel.

In the weeks following Hurricane Maria’s devastating impact on Puerto Rico, letterpress printers from around the US were invited to participate in raising funds for Puerto Rican recovery by printing a bilingual broadside by a Puerto Rican poet for this limited edition collection. Thirteen printers from around the US participated: Chaz Nove, Karen Carcia, Laura Brown, E. Mena, Kimberly Maher, Candy Gonzalez, Emily Tipps, MC Hyland, S. Glemot, C.Lawrence, Katharine DeLamater, Dan Wood, and Elana Schwartzman. A limited edition of 10 complete sets of broadsides signed by the authors in a clamshell box were made. One is held at the John Hay Special Collections Library at Brown University, another is held at the University of Arizona Tuscon Poetry Center. 100% of sales were donated directly to Taller Salud to assist Puerto Rico in recovering from Hurricane Maria.

E. Rowan Mena is a Puerto Rican poet, translator, and book artist. They hold an MFA in poetry from Brown University, an MFA in literary translation from the University of Iowa, and an M.Phil in Criticism and Culture from the University of Cambridge. Their book Featherbone (Ricochet Editions, 2015) won a 2016 Hoffer First Horizons Award. Their translation of the Argentine graphic novel The Eternaut by H.G. Oesterheld and F. Solano Lopez (Fantagraphics, 2015) won a 2016 Eisner Award. Their artist books are held in collections widely, including at the Whitney Museum of American Art. They have taught Book Arts, Translation, and Poetry at Brown University, Mills College, Harvard University, and elsewhere. They currently live in Fiskars, Finland. Find and follow Rowan (for free) on Patreon (patreon.com/acyborgkitty) or Instagram (instagram.com/acyborgkitty).

Rust byder velkommen til det første danske klub show med Mike Tramps White Lion efter hans store internationale turne i 2024. 
Ovenpå en succesfuld solokarriere, og senest to dansksprogede album udgivelser, har Mike Tramp nu genindspillet de sange, der i 80er og 90'erne gjorde ham til international stjerne med megabandet White Lion. 

Rockbandet, der red øverst på MTV-bølgen, strøg til tops på Billboard-listen og turnerede USA med Aerosmith, Kiss, AC/DC og Ozzy Osbourne,og de tidsløse rockklassikere rammer stadig det modne publikum lige i hjertet.

White Lion udgav i perioden 1983-1991 fire album, der tilsammen solgte i milliontal,og indeholdt internationale hits som “When the Children Cry”, “Little Fighter”, “Wait”,“Lady of the Valley” og “Radar Love”.

For heavy rock-fans har Mike Tramp opnået legendestatus, og han ikke bleg for at anerkende, at en del af hans publikum stadig knuselsker den Mike Tramp, der stod i front for netop White Lion.

På The Songs Of White Lion (2023) og The Songs Of White Lion II (2024) , genfortolker Mike Tramp udvalgte sange fra White Lion kataloget. Albummene blev produceret i samarbejde med Søren Andersen (Electric Guitars, Sanne Salomonsen, Stine Vega, Glenn Hughes m.fl).

Dannet i 1989 i Isla Vista, Californien, blev bandet hurtigt kendt for deres humoristiske tilgang til rockgenren og deres unikke mix af hård rock, metal og alternative lyde. Med hits som ’Everything About You’ og ’Cats in the Cradle’, blev de et af de mest markante bands fra 90’erne. 

Ugly Kid Joe har udgivet flere platin-certificerede albums, herunder de ikoniske ’As Ugly as They Wanna Be’ (1991) og ’America's Least Wanted’ (1992), der begge har haft stor indflydelse på rockscenen. 

Efter bandets opløsning i 1997 genforenedes de i 2010 og har siden været aktive. I 2015 udgav de ’Uglier Than They Used ta Be’, som var deres første album i knap 19 år, og i 2022 fulgte de op med ’Rad Wings of Destiny’, der markerede deres første album i syv år.

Berlin-based DJ and producer Stina Francina originates from Gothenburg, Sweden. Drawing inspiration from the vibrant energy and sensation of freedom found in those spaces, Stina's sets and productions radiate a highly energetic and playful yet raw emotional vibe, with an emphasis on a driving narrative and a tendency to convey feelings that often lean towards melancholic yet hopeful and yearning. While influenced by a wide range of genres, she holds a special soft spot for old-school trance, which often shines through in her sets and productions as they are infused with similar emotional atmospheres while reinterpreted with a fresh and personal twist.

Maurinstarr is a Danish producer and co-founder of the label Vile Immerse, a driving force in the new wave of Scandinavian electronic music. His style is rooted in psytrance, progressive, and techno, blending heavy grooves with psychedelic textures. Earlier this year, he toured across North America and recently released a 10-track album on Vile Immerse. Through both his releases and dynamic DJ sets, Maurinstarr is steadily building a strong presence on the international stage.

name: PEACH
description:
Klassisk pop og rock
Rock- og popbandet, Peach, har travlt. Bandet spiller jobs i hele landet, og kan mere end nogensinde mærke, at de største rock- og pophits fra de seneste syv årtier, krydret med fire spilleglade mænd, rykker.
”Vi har efterhånden spillet i 25 år, og vi kan mere end nogensinde mærke, at der er brug for et liveband, som virkelig får tilhørerne op ad stolene. Om det gælder private fester som fx bryllupper eller fødselsdage, firmafester eller ganske almindelige hverdagsaftener på offentlige steder, så ryger stemningen i vejret. Om det er fordi vi har været karantæneramte og siddet hjemme alene, der gør, at vi er mere feststemte end nogensinde, skal jeg ikke kunne sige. Men vi kan i hvert fald mærke, at der er hårdt brug for at holde fest over hele landet”, siger Martin Aaes Pedersen, der er forsanger og rytmeguitarist i bandet Peach. Udover spillejobs i Danmark har bandet også været inviteret til at spille i udlandet, bl.a. ved større arrangementer flere forskellige steder i Spanien og Grækenland. Et enkelt krydstogt er det endda også blevet til.
Peach har et bredt repertoire, som omfatter mere end 160 populære musiknumre hentet fra de sidste syv årtier – heriblandt numre med Gasolin, The Beatles, Shubidua, Rolling Stones, Tom Petty og rigtig mange andre. Peach spiller numrene ud fra tesen: Numre du havde glemt, du elskede. Peach har erfaring fra spillejobs af alle typer, og spiller både elektrisk og akustisk – alt efter, hvad der passer bedst til lejligheden. Der er tale om en klassisk rockopstilling med to guitarer, bas, trommer og en vokal. ”Lidt som en spøg udleverede vi på et tidspunkt vores liste med sange til et selskab, der blev ved med at ønske sange de ville høre – for at gå med på legen. Det blev så stor en succes, så vi faktisk har gjort det til noget vi tilbyder de selskaber vi spiller for. Vi kalder det Live Jukebox. Så får selskabet en liste med mere end 160 sangtitler, som de så kan vælge imellem og råbe, hvad de vil høre. Det giver en super fin stemning til festen, og folk er rigtig meget med til at sætte deres eget præg.”, fortæller Peter Altmann, der er trommeslager i Peach.
”Peach er et rock- og popband med attitude. Vi har, på Copenhagen Marriott Hotel, flere gange haft fornøjelsen af Peach i forbindelse med personalefester og kundearrangementer. Hver gang har Peach til fulde levet op til vores forventninger. De er altid mere end veloplagte, og publikum har hver gang nydt og danset til de fede toner. Peach har et stort repertoire og kan spille næsten al slags musik. Underholdende og levende! Perfekt timing og total publikumstække”, udtaler PR- og Sales Administrator, Lisbeth Friis, Copenhagen Mariott Hotel.
Peach har eksisteret siden 1998, men startede som en duo på en højskole i 1996. Bandet spiller over hele Danmark, både i forbindelse med private og offentlige arrangementer.
Den klassiske rock- og popgenre er repræsenteret ved sange, som tidsmæssigt spænder fra 1950’erne og frem til i dag.
Peach består af Martin Aaes Pedersen (vokal og rytmeguitar), Rasmus Dalby Sloth Aaes (bas) Peter Altmann (trommer og kor) og Claus Jørgen Toustrup (leadguitar og kor).

This summer, Haven transforms into a backyard cinema under the sky 🌃 Welcome to Bio Bio — our new open-air film series where we’re screening cult classics, hidden gems, and unforgettable stories for free.

We’ve set the scene with a big screen, cozy seating, and a brand new popcorn machine ready to fire. The bar will be open, the evenings long, and the atmosphere casual — come by solo, with friends, or drop in midway through. 
It’s cinema without the rules, just how we like it.


UPCOMING DATES

📽️ May 21 | 17 - 00
Pusher I–III (Nicolas Winding Refn)
Our first night is Wednesday, May 21, and we’re kicking things off with a bang — all three films in Nicolas Winding Refn’s Pusher Trilogy. Raw, gritty, and iconic, these films helped define the Danish crime genre and launched Mads Mikkelsen's career.
Please note: These films contain graphic violence and are recommended for ages 15 and up.
__________

📽️ June 11
Valhalla (1986) vs Valhalla (2019)
Two films. One myth.
For the second edition of Bio Bio, we travel from Midgård to Asgård in the company of Thor, Loke, and two mortal children: Tjalfe and Røskva. First in the 1986 animated cult classic based on Peter Madsen’s beloved comics — then in Fenar Ahmad’s 2019 reimagining, where the gods are falling, and belief is breaking apart.
It’s a story about giants, goats, cosmic mischief, and the quiet power of ordinary mortals — told in two very different cinematic languages, across more than 30 years of Danish film history.
__________

📽️ June 25 |
Gammel Dansk
This Wednesday, we’re heading back to the good old Danish days — or were they really that great? Join us under the summer sky for a nostalgic comedy double feature, packed with commune dreams and crumbling fishing empires.

To help ease the flashbacks, we’ll be serving 𝑑𝑒𝑙𝑖𝑐𝑖𝑜𝑢𝑠 Gammel Dansk — the kind of shot people actually drank in the 70s and 80s, before we figured out alcohol could taste nice.

🎞 Det Store Flip (1997)
Copenhagen, 1972. Christoffer’s parents dive headfirst into hippie life with hash, communes, and Marx — much to his teenage dismay. 

🎞 Bornholms Stemme (1999)
Early 1980s Bornholm. Captain Lars Erik rules the waves — until fishing quotas and shifting tides threaten everything the island’s fishing kings hold dear.

Det Store Flip will feature English subtitles.

__________

📽️ July 16 |
Hurt men hurt men
We’re diving into the gritty side of Copenhagen with two modern Danish classics:
🎞 Nordvest (2013) and 🎞 Ækte Vare (2014).

Both films capture the raw pulse of the city’s streets, following young men caught between ambition, loyalty, and the harsh realities of the underground. It’s street-level storytelling with heart, violence, and a soundtrack that slaps – perfect for a summer night under the stars.

name: Elkka, Gavnlig, Eliott Litrowski, DJ Estrella, DJ LoveCatt
description:
Written over the space of 18 months, Prism of Pleasure encapsulates Elkka’s essence as a bold, queer woman who pushes freedom and sensuality to the forefront of her work. It hasn’t always been like this: born and raised in South Wales, with next to no queer community in her immediate vicinity, Elkka had to piece together her identity slowly and curiously, gradually finding herself along the way. 
After coming out and moving to London in her 20s, the musician started DJing, writing and producing, which eventually led to her launching her own record label, femme culture, and running her own queer club nights off the back of that. “I think sometimes things unlock, and start to make sense and then you just follow it,” Elkka says now. “I started to go out more and become part of a community. I was more confident in myself, so I was more confident in writing and producing – it all came together at the same time.” 
Written around the notion of queer intimacy, Prism of Pleasure is like a peep into a steam-filled room of wonders, via the female gaze (a concept beautifully represented in the pink-tinged album artwork, photographed by Elkka’s wife and longtime creative collaborator Alex Lambert). From the smooth, silken vocals of “Crushhh” to the slow-winding, breathy beats of “Your Skin” (“I’m breathing you in, I want to taste every inch of your skin”) and the steady, undulating synth patterns of “surrender2me”, Prism of Pleasure unfurls like a patchwork of sweat-slick nights, emotional connectedness and hidden pleasures. “It’s like a celebration of [how far] I’ve come,” explains Elkka. “I was never taught about queer pleasure. I was never taught how important that is – not just sexually but generally in life. So I wanted to explore all of that more deeply.” Ultimately, Prism of Pleasure is the result of Elkka opening herself up in new ways, and being as authentic as possible. “I wanted a rawness to this album,” she says. “It’s something that can be felt, and that helps you connect with someone that’s listening to it, if you’re willing to expose a part of yourself. And again, this is all really transferable to relationships, and being with someone, all of that stuff and that’s why these things overlap for me. I gave everything I could, and hopefully that translates.”

name: Ellen Allien (DE), Vixen, Ida Aya, Afgang, Crisco
description:
As one of the most iconic artists of her generation, Ellen Allien embodies the core ethos of techno: a visionary who looks to the future for inspiration, carving out her own niche and presiding over an empire that has imbued techno, and dance music culture, with her unique DNA. Her latest LP, AurAA, dropped in June 2020 featured a variety of hard-hitting, rave-inspired techno cuts, but all delivered with Ellen’s idiosyncratic sound signature; high-octane beats and distinct use of vocals with irresistible rhythms and grooves, which create listening and emotional qualities that resonate beyond the dancefloor. Unable to tour in 2020, she conceived the Balcony Streaming sessions, hosted from her home in Berlin. The livestreams allowed her to continue DJing and engaging with her fanbase, while also supporting music from a wide range of artists, new and old. She channeled her curatorial experience into an expansive three-part compilation series. Named after her We Are Not Alone parties, the collection comprised 33 tracks from artists that embody the ethos of the brand; club music with a rugged aesthetic and an unapologetic dance floor focus. Her most recent releases are tracks on compilations by the collectives Gegen Berlin and Serendeepity. Before the end of 2021 she'll release the remixes of one of her favorite bands Lebanon Hanover on BPitch - originally created for her own sets and released by popular demand - a new EP for her label UFO Inc, and a remix for Regal.

name: I. JORDAN (GB), Ena Cosovic, B From E
description:
I. JORDAN is a pivotal influence in UK dance music culture. Since their debut release in 2019, the Doncaster-born, London-based DJ and producer has blazed trails with rave-infused house and techno steeped in Northern culture. I. JORDAN has become known for a specific brand of euphoric house that transcends dancefloors and speaks straight to the human spirit. They’ve won numerous awards, remixed Romy, Fred Again, TSHA and Pet Shop Boys, toured with Fred Again and Flume, and sold out shows around the world, from London to Manchester, Tokyo to Sydney. Jordan gained international recognition with their debut album I AM JORDAN, chosen as one of BBC 6’s album of the year in 2024. I. JORDAN sees art and activism as inextricable, promoting queer empowerment and supporting marginalized communities through workshops, productions and shows. Jordan launched their live show format in 2024, combining live programming and guitar with visuals, dancers and vocalists. Their recent music explores deep emotional expression, championing true authenticity, and rejecting society’s ideas of how they should exist in the world. And by embodying their most authentic self, they hope others feel liberated to do the same.

name: Oscar Ployart Quintet ft Per ‘Texas’ Johansson
description:
Oscar Ployart Quintet featuring Per ‘Texas’ Johansson er et nyt band, der spiller smuk og fantasifuld jazzmusik med en stærk melodisk kvalitet. Med udforskende og humoristiske originale kompositioner skrevet af Oscar, skaber bandet musik inspireret af Charles Mingus, nordisk nostalgi og den amerikanske tradition for swing og groove. Resultatet er moderne skandinavisk jazz og en levende musikalsk oplevelse, som måske kan hjælpe publikum finde mening i hverdagens virvar. 

Per ‘Texas’ Johansson, en af de helt store helte i skandinavisk jazz, er med på saxofon. Han har i løbet af sin karriere været en af de ledende stemmer i det svenske jazzmiljø og har indspillet nogle af de vigtigste og mest stilskabende jazzplader i Norden. 

Oscar voksede op på en gård i Nordjylland og har altid været betaget af musik. Efter en forelskelse i jazz-improvisations uimodståelige swing og energi begav han sig mod Amsterdam for at studere på konservatoriet. Der bor han stadig og er sædvanligvis at finde boksende med tangenterne et sted i byen eller på en turné i Europa med forskellige projekter.

name: Postkolonial arv og nutidige kampe // August - september 2025
description:
------------------------------------
OM SERIEN
------------------------------------

Postkolonial arv og nutidige kampe
Frantz Fanon fylder 100 år - og slår stadig gnister

Frantz Fanon, der ville være fyldt 100 år i juli 2025, er en af det 20. århundredes mest indflydelsesrige intellektuelle stemmer inden for postkolonial teori, psykiatri og frigørelsesfilosofi.  

Hans berømte udsagn, “Frihed er ikke en gave, den er en erobring,” står som et radikalt kald til handling, og bøger som Fanons ‘Black Skin, White Masks’ og ‘The Wretched of the Earth’ har haft enorm betydning for forståelsen af kolonialismens psykologiske og politiske konsekvenser. 

Denne filmserie undersøger den revolutionære tænkers fortsatte relevans.

Frantz Fanon var en alsidig intellektuel, der virkede som psykiater, filosof, revolutionær aktivist og forfatter. Hans arbejde spænder fra dybdegående psykologiske analyser af kolonialismens virkninger på individet til skarpe politiske skrifter, der inspirerede befrielsesbevægelser verden over. 

Frantz Fanon blev født på Martinique, studerede medicin og psykiatri i Frankrig og arbejdede som overlæge i Algeriet under uafhængighedskrigen. Han tilbragte sine sidste år som aktivist i Tunesien, hvor han døde som 36-årig. Hans erfaringer i Caribien, Europa og Nordafrika formede hans tænkning om kolonialisme, identitet og frihed.

Som både kliniker og ideolog fungerede han som et vigtigt bindeled mellem teori og praksis i kampen mod undertrykkelse og racisme, og tænkere som Edward Said, Homi Bhabha og Achille Mbembe anerkendt at stå på skuldrene af Fanons arbejde. Han er stadig et centralt referencepunkt i kritisk tænkning om magt, race og modstand.

Fanons synspunkter har også mødt kritik, blandt andet for sin fremhævelse af voldens rolle, og nogle har diskuteret hans behandling af køn og identitet. Med andre ord: Han læses og lever fortsat, her 100 år efter sin fødsel og små 64 år efter hans alt for tidlige død.

Denne filmserie undersøger Fanons liv og tanker gennem både essayfilm, actionfilm, dokumentarer og politiske dramaer. Filmene åbner op for både en hyldest til og en kritisk dialog om hans arv og viser, hvordan hans idéer fortsat former samtaler om kolonialismens eftervirkninger og nutidens kampe for retfærdighed.

Rasmus Brendstrup, programredaktør / Cinemateket

description:

August 2 + 3, kl. 20:00 @ DR Koncerthuset, Koncertsalen

● Lørdag 2/8, billetter: https://bit.ly/cjf2025herbienight1
● Søndag 3/8, billetter: https://bit.ly/cjf2025herbienight2

Få kunstnere i musikhistorien har som Herbøie Hancock (f. 1940) haft større indflydelse på krydsfeltet mellem jazz, funk og populærmusik. Miles Davis skrev i sin berømte selvbiografi fra 1989: “Herbie was the step after Bud Powell and Thelonious Monk - and I haven’t heard anybody yet who has come after him.”

Hancock nyder velfortjent ikonstatus efter et halvt århundredes konstant innovation af rytmisk musik, hvilket har ført ham gennem flere markante stilskift. Han albumdebuterede på Blue Note i 1962, og allerede året efter blev han - sammen med Wayne Shorter - medlem af Miles Davis’ banebrydende kvintet. Sideløbende udgav han det ene stærke jazzalbum efter det andet, indtil den elektriske jazz for alvor pressede sig på - først med Miles Davis' "Bitches Brew" og sidenhen med Herbie-albums som "Mwandishi", "The Headhunters", "Thrust" og "Secrets". Senere kom samarbejdet med Joni Mitchell, Paul Simon og mange andre af tidens store sangskrivere. 

I alt har Herbie Hancock modtaget 14 Grammyer til dato, og hans fantastiske diskografi tæller hits som bl.a. “Cantaloupe Island”, “Maiden Voyage”, “Chameleon”, “I Thought It Was You”, “Watermelon Man” og “Rockit”, der har leveret materiale til utallige samples og var med til at præge hiphoppens tidlige år.

DR Koncerthuset og Copenhagen Jazz Festival er stolte af at kunne præsentere en af musikhistoriens største skikkelser, når Herbie Hancock med band vender tilbage til Koncertsalen med to koncerter i august, hvor der netop er meldt "få billetter" til den første aften, lørdag d. 2. august.

Første koncert i årets program præsenterer en stjernekvintet i international klasse. De spiller to centrale værker for fem strygere. Far og søn Brantelid og bratschstjerneskuddet Nicolas Swensen fra Danmark sammen med Benjamin Schmid fra Wien og russisk/engelske Alexander Sitkovetsky – i alt fem strygere på absolut verdensplan!

I sensommeren 1828 fik Franz Schubert at vide, at han snart skulle dø af syfilis. Med den viden skrev han sit sidste kammermusikværk: en strygekvintet. Ikke som normalt med en ekstra bratsch koblet på strygekvartetten, men med en ekstra cello, som mørkner stemningen og giver kvintetten en særligt fyldig klangverden. Den løsning tog russiske Aleksandr Glazunov til sig, da han som kun 26-årig skrev sin kvintet fuld af opfindsomhed, energi, melodisk glæde og rustik charme.

Once again, the Classical Summer Concerts are delighted to present a range of world-class musicians, performing amongst the Roman gods and heroes in the Glyptotek’s atmospheric Central Hall.  

The first concert in this year's program presents a star quintet that has won international praise. They play two central works for five string instruments. Father and son Brantelid and the viola star Nicolas Swensen from Denmark together with Benjamin Schmid from Vienna and Russian/English Alexander Sitkovetsky – a total of five string players of absolute world class! 

In the late summer of 1828, Franz Schubert was told that he would soon die of syphilis. With this knowledge, he wrote his last chamber music work: a string quintet. Not as usual with an extra viola coupled to the string quartet, but with an extra cello, which darkens the atmosphere and gives the quintet a particularly rich soundscape. This solution was adopted by the Russian Aleksandr Glazunov when, at only 26 years old, he wrote his quintet full of ingenuity, energy, melodic joy and rustic charm.

name: Sommerferie på Glyptoteket: Blomster og historier
description:
Lav fantasifulde papirsblomster og kom med på spændende guidede ture, hvor vi kigger efter blomster og planter og hører gode historier i hele skolernes sommerferie.

I sommerferien kan børn og deres voksne gå på opdagelse i de blomster og planter, man kan finde i Glyptotekets kunst og arkitektur, og så kan I selv give jer i kast med at lave jeres egne sjove, flotte og fantasifulde blomster!

Hver dag tager Glyptotekets værter imod på tæpperne i Vinterhaven. Her kan I lave blomster i farverigt crepepapir, som I kan få med jer hjem eller ”plante” i et fællesbed på museet. I kan også sidde og tegne eller farvelægge.

Kl. 11.30 og kl. 14 vil der i hele sommerferieperioden være guidede ture på museet, hvor vi kigger efter blomster og planter og hører gode historier: En palme forbereder sig på at dø, en kunstmaler finder håb i lyserøde roser, og en dreng forvandles til en påskelilje. Historierne varierer fra dag til dag.


FOR HVEM

For børn 5+ og deres voksne


HVORNÅR

28. juni - 10. august kl. 11-15
Tirsdag-søndag. Mandag lukket


BILLETTER

De guidede ture er gratis, når entréen til museet er betalt. Turene varer 30 min. Turbilletter kan ikke forudbestilles, men afhentes i billetsalget på dagen. Der udleveres ikke billetter til grupper på mere end fem. Større grupper henvises til at booke en privat omvisning.


NYT ÅRSKORT FOR BØRN OG DERES VOKSNE

Glyptoteket er et sted fyldt med spændende historier, kreativ inspiration og mytiske væsner. Nu kan børn få deres eget årskort og udforske museet samt de mange børneaktiviteter lige så ofte, de har lyst – og tage en valgfri voksen gratis med hver gang!

Årskortet under 18+ 1 gæst kan købes i billetsalget eller på hjemmesiden: https://billet.glyptoteket.dk/aarskortunder18

name: POEMA SUELTO: Exhibition + Workshop + Book Show
description:
Rooted in print as a political and poetic tool, POEMA SUELTO explores how language, translation, and small-scale publishing become acts of resistance:

Opening: Friday, August 2, 2025
Workshop: 14:00 (registration required – fee 400 DKK
register via reddoorcph@gmail.com)
Learn more here:
https://reddoormagazine.com/product/workshop-poema-suelto-publication-in-non-traditional-formats-bookmaking-aug-02-25/

EXHIBITION & Book Show
Opening & Welcome Drinks: 16:30–18:30
@ Red Door Gallery: Møllegade 23a kld 2200 KBH N
Exhibition: free 

Red Door Gallery presents POEMA SUELTO, featuring poetic broadsides and translation prints by E. Rowan Mena, and a curated book show by La Impresora, the independent Puerto Rican poetry press and Risograph studio founded and co-directed by the poets Nicole Cecilia Delgado and Amanda Hernández— we'll be honored to have Nicole visiting Red Door, giving a workshop, and present throughout the exhibition opening.

ABOUT THE WORK:

La Impresora—established in 2016 and based in Isabela, Puerto Rico—is both a small‑scale press and print workshop. Its editorial mandate is to publish contemporary Puerto Rican poetry by underrepresented writers and to strengthen the dialogue between literature and visual art.

Working with non-toxic, vegetable-based inks and a sustainable, analog Risograph process, the press produces beautifully crafted, limited-edition artist books, chapbooks, broadsides, and zines. Through series such as Trabajo de Poesía, Primeros Libros, Poema Suelto, Crónica, and Independientes, La Impresora supports emerging writers, experimental formats, and self-managed publishing.

----

E. Rowan Mena is a Puerto Rican poet, translator, and book artist. They hold an MFA in poetry from Brown University, an MFA in literary translation from the University of Iowa, and an M.Phil in Criticism and Culture from the University of Cambridge. Their book Featherbone (Ricochet Editions, 2015) won a 2016 Hoffer First Horizons Award. Their translation of the Argentine graphic novel The Eternaut by H.G. Oesterheld and F. Solano Lopez (Fantagraphics, 2015) won a 2016 Eisner Award. Their artist books are held in collections widely, including at the Whitney Museum of American Art. They have taught Book Arts, Translation, and Poetry at Brown University, Mills College, Harvard University, and elsewhere. They currently live in Fiskars, Finland. Find and follow Rowan (for free) on Patreon (patreon.com/acyborgkitty) or Instagram (instagram.com/acyborgkitty).
 

____


14:00 – Workshop
POEMA SUELTO: Publication in Non-traditional Formats led by Nicole Cecilia Delgado
Fee: 400 DKK – limited places – register via reddoorcph@gmail.com


Hands-on session crafting four different single-page publication formats inspired by Poema Suelto publications. Materials provided; participants may bring their own text.


EXHIBITION OPENING: 
16:30–18:30 – Opening Drinks & Artist Meet-up
Browse the exhibition and book show; meet Nicole Cecilia Delgado and hear of opportunities to collaborate and be part of upcoming Red Door projects.

All are welcome. Exhibition free of charge. 
*Workshop requires registration.

www.reddoor.dk

ABOUT NICOLE CECILIA DELGADO: 

Nicole Cecilia Delgado (www.nicolececiliadelgado.net) is a poet, translator, and book artist born in San Juan, Puerto Rico. Her writing, often reviewed within the framework of ecofeminism and land art, explores the subtleties and contrasts of everyday Puerto Rican and Caribbean life. Her collection of poems Periodo especial (Ediciones Aguadulce & La Impresora, 2019), deals with the fiscal crisis in Puerto Rico through the socioeconomic mirrors of the Greater Antilles. She recently published A mano/By Hand, an autobiographical essay about independent publishing (Ugly Duckling Presse Pamphlet Series 2020, La Impresora/EEE, 2023), and the bilingual poetry anthology Adjacent Islands/islas adyacentes (Ugly Duckling Presse, 2022, translated to English by Urayoán Noel).  She is the founder and co-director of La Impresora, a poetry press and Risograph print shop dedicated to small-scale editorial work in Puerto Rico. She is one of the 2025 Artists in Residence at Artica Svalvard, nominated by the Queen Sonja Print Award. 

ABOUT THE EXHIBITION: 
Puerto Rico En Mi Corazón is a collection of broadsides of contemporary Puerto Rican poets, in English and in Spanish. Edited by Roque Salas Rivera, E. Rowan Mena, Ricardo Alberto Maldonado, and Carina del Valle Schorske, coordinated by Anomalous Press.

Including poems by Yolanda Arroyo Pizarro, Andrés Cerpa, Kenneth Cumba, Joey de Jesus, Nicole Delgado, Martín Espada, Cindy Jimenez Vera, Yara Liceaga, Ricardo Maldonado, Lara Mimosa Montes, Urayoan Noel, Mara Pastor, Yolanda Rivera Castillo, Gaddiel Francisco Ruiz Rivera, Nicole Seale, Vincent Toro, and Xavier Valcárcel.

In the weeks following Hurricane Maria’s devastating impact on Puerto Rico, letterpress printers from around the US were invited to participate in raising funds for Puerto Rican recovery by printing a bilingual broadside by a Puerto Rican poet for this limited edition collection. Thirteen printers from around the US participated: Chaz Nove, Karen Carcia, Laura Brown, E. Mena, Kimberly Maher, Candy Gonzalez, Emily Tipps, MC Hyland, S. Glemot, C.Lawrence, Katharine DeLamater, Dan Wood, and Elana Schwartzman. A limited edition of 10 complete sets of broadsides signed by the authors in a clamshell box were made. One is held at the John Hay Special Collections Library at Brown University, another is held at the University of Arizona Tuscon Poetry Center. 100% of sales were donated directly to Taller Salud to assist Puerto Rico in recovering from Hurricane Maria.
